body: On agy 1.5.9, passing --sandbox to agy when runAgy() already wraps the builder process inside Linux bwrap (bwrap_pid) or macOS sandbox-exec (seatbelt) causes agy to attempt a nested CLONE_NEWUSER or sandbox_init for every run_command tool call, failing with fork/exec agy: operation not permitted on Linux hosts with kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=1. In lib/agy.mjs, omit --sandbox from the inner agy argv when containmentCheck.mechanism is bwrap_pid or seatbelt (outer kernel containment remains mandatory and unchanged; non-builder sandbox:true calls continue passing --sandbox). Add regression assertions in test/agy.test.mjs, rebuild dist/** via npm run build, and verify test/agy.test.mjs, test/unit.test.mjs, and test/builder-stream-json.test.mjs pass.
title: Omit nested agy --sandbox inside outer bwrap_pid and seatbelt builder containment
